assessment_summary.project_name: CFD of an Axial Fan in AMCA 210 Plenum
assessment_summary.cou_name: Select axial fan/RPM to achieve Δp ≥ 325 Pa at Q = 1.20 m³/s for a data center rack

evidence_keywords: A 37-point rotating CFD checklist was followed
All meshes, case/data files, and scripts are in Git with semantic version tags
CI job runs a small regression case nightly to flag solver environment drift
independent reviewer (J. Yuan)
Fluent build hash logged
laminar Poiseuille flow case (3D rectangular duct)
rotating cavity (simplified lid-driven rotor)
turbulent channel at Re_τ ≈ 395
method of manufactured solutions (MMS)
three-level mesh refinement study
refinement ratio ≈ 1.4
Roache procedure with apparent order p ≈ 2.1
estimated remaining grid uncertainty on Δp at the fine mesh is 1.2%
Residuals reach 10^-6 in all equations
torque and Δp plateaus achieved over the final 500 iterations
Mass imbalance < 0.05%
ramped outlet pressure and swirl correction to avoid false convergence
hash-based checks to prevent accidental changes in boundary assignments
Boundary naming and frame definitions are tested by a script
Units are enforced via a linter script
Sign-off by independent reviewer (J. Yuan)
Steady RANS; MRF in the rotor cell zone
Baseline: SST k–ω with curvature correction
Compressibility: Ignored (Ma < 0.3 rule of thumb)
The steady RANS approach cannot capture rotating stall inception with fidelity
Geometry from vendor CAD (STEP, Rev. K)
Tip clearance measured with feeler gauges
Inlet turbulence intensity measured in the test duct with a hot-wire
Air properties derived from lab logs
Each operating point measured in triplicate
standard deviation in Δp < 0.7% of mean
flow rate repeatability < 0.6%
AMCA 210-16 test conducted in Epsilon’s Lab 2
Arrangement 1 (free inlet)
All sensors calibrated within six months; certificates archived
Air density corrections per AMCA
We modeled the plenum, bellmouth, and measurement section sufficiently to reproduce the boundary conditions
density set per test condition for paired comparisons
RPM verified with optical tachometer
predicted Δp at 1600 RPM and Q = 1.20 m³/s is 332 Pa
The test mean is 327 Pa
mean absolute deviation between CFD and test across eight points is 2.3%
Torque prediction within 2.6%

expected_factors.factor_type: Relevance of the quantities of interest
evidence_keywords: Decision need: Determine if the fan satisfies Δp ≥ 325 Pa at Q = 1.20 m³/s
We applied CFD to predict the pressure-flow (P–Q) curve
Primary decision point is 1600 RPM

expected_factors.factor_type: Relevance of the validation activities to the COU
evidence_keywords: in-house AMCA 210-16 lab
The spatial correspondence ensures the comparison is like-for-like
within the validated envelope; no extrapolation is required

expected_decision.outcome_source: we recommend selecting the next higher RPM setting (1650 RPM nominal)
rationale_keywords: Given the narrow margin to the target
the 95% prediction interval on Δp at 1.20 m³/s and 1600 RPM is about ±4.6% relative
